test-code.description: bad: FileInputStream in use block without buffering
test-code.code:
import java.io.FileInputStream
fun bad(name: String): ByteArray = FileInputStream(name).use { it.readBytes() } // bad

test-code.description: bad: FileOutputStream in use block without buffering
test-code.code:
import java.io.FileOutputStream
fun bad(name: String, data: ByteArray) = FileOutputStream(name).use { it.write(data) } // bad

import java.io.BufferedInputStream import java.io.FileInputStream
fun good(name: String): ByteArray = BufferedInputStream(FileInputStream(name)).use { it.readBytes() }

import java.io.BufferedOutputStream import java.io.FileOutputStream
fun good(name: String, data: ByteArray) = BufferedOutputStream(FileOutputStream(name)).use { it.write(data) }
